# Cocos2d runtime

Source: https://github.com/cocos2d/cocos2d-html5
Revision: `c0324ad511b7e327a597d9a0d27e5a7d9f4fbc07` (develop branch, downloaded 2026-10-02).

The engine source is vendored for offline, dependency-free runtime use. It boots through `CCBoot.js` and `project.json`; this game uses the core and shape-nodes modules with the Canvas renderer. The supplied MIT licenses remain under `cocos2d/licenses/`. No engine files have been modified.
